scenarios.name: Inspect controls in the recent-documents region

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
that opened part is listed in recent documents
the recent-documents region shows an ordering control labeled By Ordered List
a separate display control is visible beside it
each visible recent-document row shows a document-type symbol and name on the left
each visible row shows a pin control on the right
the active part remains visible around the menu
the menu closes and the same part remains active
